title: "Taylor Swift Album Explorer"
format:

Explore and compare cover art across all 11 Taylor Swift studio album eras.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Explorer

::: {.album-explorer style="max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center;"}

```{=html}
<div class="mb-4">
  <label for="album-select" class="form-label fw-bold">Select an Album:</label>
  <select id="album-select" class="form-select form-select-lg" style="max-width: 450px; margin: 0 auto;">
    <option value="0">Taylor Swift (2006)</option>
    <option value="1">Fearless (2008)</option>
    <option value="2">Speak Now (2010)</option>
    <option value="3">Red (2012)</option>
    <option value="4">1989 (2014)</option>
    <option value="5">reputation (2017)</option>
    <option value="6" selected>Lover (2019)</option>
    <option value="7">folklore (2020)</option>
    <option value="8">evermore (2020)</option>
    <option value="9">Midnights (2022)</option>
    <option value="10">The Tortured Poets Department (2024)</option>
  </select>
</div>

<div class="card shadow-sm border-0 mb-4 p-3 bg-light" style="border-radius: 16px;">
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-center">
    <img id="album-cover" src="data/07_lover.jpg" alt="Album Cover" class="img-fluid rounded shadow" style="max-height: 400px; object-fit: contain;">
  </div>
  <div class="card-body">
    <h3 id="album-title" class="card-title mt-2 fw-bold">Lover</h3>
    <p id="album-meta" class="text-muted mb-0">Released in 2019 &bull; Album #7</p>
  </div>
</div>

<h5 class="fw-bold mb-3">All Studio Albums</h5>
<div id="thumb-grid" class="d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-center gap-2 mb-4"></div>
```

:::

## Compare Albums

Compare the visual styles, color palettes, and eras of any two albums side-by-side.

```{=html}
<div class="row text-center mt-3 g-4">
  <div class="col-md-6">
    <div class="card shadow-sm border-0 p-3 bg-light h-100" style="border-radius: 16px;">
      <label for="compare-left" class="form-label fw-bold">Album A:</label>
      <select id="compare-left" class="form-select mb-3"></select>
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-center mb-3" style="min-height: 320px; align-items: center;">
        <img id="img-left" class="img-fluid rounded shadow" style="max-height: 300px; object-fit: contain;">
      </div>
      <h4 id="title-left" class="fw-bold"></h4>
      <p id="meta-left" class="text-muted mb-0"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
  
  <div class="col-md-6">
    <div class="card shadow-sm border-0 p-3 bg-light h-100" style="border-radius: 16px;">
      <label for="compare-right" class="form-label fw-bold">Album B:</label>
      <select id="compare-right" class="form-select mb-3"></select>
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-center mb-3" style="min-height: 320px; align-items: center;">
        <img id="img-right" class="img-fluid rounded shadow" style="max-height: 300px; object-fit: contain;">
      </div>
      <h4 id="title-right" class="fw-bold"></h4>
      <p id="meta-right" class="text-muted mb-0"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const albums = [
  { title: "Taylor Swift", year: 2006, file: "data/01_taylor_swift.jpg", num: 1, vibe: "Country / Debut" },
  { title: "Fearless", year: 2008, file: "data/02_fearless.jpg", num: 2, vibe: "Country Pop / Golden Glow" },
  { title: "Speak Now", year: 2010, file: "data/03_speak_now.jpg", num: 3, vibe: "Country Rock / Fairytale Purple" },
  { title: "Red", year: 2012, file: "data/04_red.jpg", num: 4, vibe: "Pop & Heartbreak / Crimson" },
  { title: "1989", year: 2014, file: "data/05_1989.jpg", num: 5, vibe: "80s Synth-pop / Polaroid" },
  { title: "reputation", year: 2017, file: "data/06_reputation.jpg", num: 6, vibe: "Electropop / Monochrome Gothic" },
  { title: "Lover", year: 2019, file: "data/07_lover.jpg", num: 7, vibe: "Pastel Pop / Dreamy Sunset" },
  { title: "folklore", year: 2020, file: "data/08_folklore.jpg", num: 8, vibe: "Indie Folk / Misty Woodland" },
  { title: "evermore", year: 2020, file: "data/09_evermore.jpg", num: 9, vibe: "Alternative / Winter Plaid" },
  { title: "Midnights", year: 2022, file: "data/10_midnights.jpg", num: 10, vibe: "Late-night Pop / Vintage Haze" },
  { title: "The Tortured Poets Department", year: 2024, file: "data/11_the_tortured_poets_department.jpg", num: 11, vibe: "Literary Pop / Sepia & Shadows" }
];

// Single Explorer Logic
const select = document.getElementById("album-select");
const cover = document.getElementById("album-cover");
const title = document.getElementById("album-title");
const meta = document.getElementById("album-meta");
const grid = document.getElementById("thumb-grid");

function showAlbum(index) {
  const a = albums[index];
  cover.src = a.file;
  cover.alt = a.title + " Album Cover";
  title.textContent = a.title;
  meta.textContent = `${a.vibe} • Released in ${a.year} • Album #${a.num}`;
  select.value = index;
  
  document.querySelectorAll(".thumb-btn").forEach((btn, i) => {
    btn.style.outline = (i == index) ? "3px solid #0d6efd" : "none";
    btn.style.opacity = (i == index) ? "1" : "0.7";
  });
}

albums.forEach((a, index) => {
  const img = document.createElement("img");
  img.src = a.file;
  img.alt = a.title;
  img.title = `${a.title} (${a.year})`;
  img.className = "thumb-btn rounded shadow-sm";
  img.style = "width: 52px; height: 52px; object-fit: cover; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease;";
  img.onclick = () => showAlbum(index);
  img.onmouseover = () => { if (select.value != index) img.style.opacity = "1"; };
  img.onmouseout = () => { if (select.value != index) img.style.opacity = "0.7"; };
  grid.appendChild(img);
});

select.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
  showAlbum(parseInt(e.target.value));
});

// Comparison Logic
const selLeft = document.getElementById("compare-left");
const selRight = document.getElementById("compare-right");
const imgLeft = document.getElementById("img-left");
const imgRight = document.getElementById("img-right");
const titleLeft = document.getElementById("title-left");
const titleRight = document.getElementById("title-right");
const metaLeft = document.getElementById("meta-left");
const metaRight = document.getElementById("meta-right");

albums.forEach((a, index) => {
  const optL = new Option(`${a.title} (${a.year})`, index);
  const optR = new Option(`${a.title} (${a.year})`, index);
  selLeft.add(optL);
  selRight.add(optR);
});

function updateCompare(side, index) {
  const a = albums[index];
  if (side === "left") {
    imgLeft.src = a.file;
    titleLeft.textContent = a.title;
    metaLeft.textContent = `${a.vibe} (${a.year})`;
  } else {
    imgRight.src = a.file;
    titleRight.textContent = a.title;
    metaRight.textContent = `${a.vibe} (${a.year})`;
  }
}

selLeft.addEventListener("change", (e) => updateCompare("left", parseInt(e.target.value)));
selRight.addEventListener("change", (e) => updateCompare("right", parseInt(e.target.value)));

// Initialize defaults
showAlbum(6); // Lover
selLeft.value = 5; // reputation
updateCompare("left", 5);
selRight.value = 6; // Lover
updateCompare("right", 6);
</script>
```

:::
